text: Here's the easiest way to learn Arabic: open the app, and press Continue.
This is رَفِيق. Let me show you everything inside.
First, your journey. One path: a reading starter, then twelve units, from greetings to hobbies.
Each step takes five to ten minutes. Meet new words, hear a conversation, learn one grammar idea, practise, then speak.
In the early units, you build sentences from word tiles. Later on, you type them yourself.
And رَفِيق brings every word back for review, just before you'd forget it.
Want something specific? Step off the path, into Practise.
Drill twenty-one common verbs in the past, present and future.
Learn the joining words that link your ideas together.
Or play the spelling bee: hear a word, then spell it in Arabic.
Go further with Complete. Practise real-life scenes, from the airport to the masjid.
Have the conversation yourself, and get feedback on every reply.
And get a review built from the mistakes you keep making.
Your journey, or something specific. A few minutes a day.
